function.name: get_tool_schema
function.description:
Get the JSON schema for one or more tools from a connected MCP server, or omit the tool names to list a server's tools and their arguments. You MUST call this for a tool before you can invoke it with invoke_tool.

## GitHub MCP

Provides 44 tools. Call get_tool_schema with "GitHub MCP" to list them.

## Notion MCP

Provides 14 tools. Call get_tool_schema with "Notion MCP" to list them.

## Pylance MCP

Provides 13 tools. Call get_tool_schema with "Pylance MCP" to list them.

server.description: The name of the MCP server to query.

tools.description: Tool names to get schemas for. Omit to list the server's tools and their arguments.

function.name: invoke_tool
function.description: Invoke a specific tool on a connected MCP server. You MUST first use get_tool_schema to retrieve the required parameters for this tool before calling invoke_tool.

server.description: The name of the MCP server that has the tool.

tool.description: The name of the tool to invoke.

arguments.description: The arguments to pass to the tool.
